cards.name: Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
cards.flavor_text: Saving the world was never the point. Saving the people in it was.

cards.name: Command Tower
cards.flavor_text: Every apocalypse looks smaller once you put it on a map.

cards.name: Savai Triome
cards.flavor_text: Every world meets somewhere. Few travelers survive the intersection.

cards.name: High Market
cards.flavor_text: Everything forbidden has a buyer. Everything cursed has a seller.

cards.name: Bloodstained Mire
cards.flavor_text: Hell had a lock. Humanity had the bad luck to find the keyhole.

cards.name: Arid Mesa
cards.flavor_text: Every hunt began somewhere between one town and the next.

cards.name: Marsh Flats
cards.flavor_text: Some graves hold bodies. Others hold doors.

cards.name: Boros Garrison
cards.flavor_text: They lost the world. They did not surrender the people in it.

cards.name: Rakdos Carnarium
cards.flavor_text: The crown changes hands. Hell never does.

cards.name: Orzhov Basilica
cards.flavor_text: The prayers stopped. The echoes didn’t.

cards.name: Blood Crypt
cards.flavor_text: Built to hold an archangel. Barely.

cards.name: Godless Shrine
cards.flavor_text: Sanctity is easier to break than to restore.

cards.name: Sacred Foundry
cards.flavor_text: Knowledge became policy. Policy became a weapon.

cards.name: Temple of Malice
cards.flavor_text: Some doors are sealed for the sake of both sides.

cards.name: Temple of Silence
cards.flavor_text: When anything can wear a familiar face, iron walls feel comforting.

cards.name: Temple of Triumph
cards.flavor_text: Every soul remembers peace differently. Heaven makes room for all of them.

cards.name: Windbrisk Heights
cards.flavor_text: Paradise was vast, beautiful, and divided into private rooms.

cards.name: Spinerock Knoll
cards.flavor_text: Nothing there evolved to welcome visitors.

cards.name: Clive's Hideaway
cards.flavor_text: Tuesday again.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.flavor_text: Hell had no shortage of rooms, only mercy.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.flavor_text: Every path led deeper. Every shadow was hungry.

cards.name: Plains
cards.flavor_text: Before angels, demons, and prophecies, there was home.

cards.name: Abandoned Air Temple
cards.flavor_text: Hunters came for answers, whiskey, and the chance not to drink alone.

cards.name: Susur Secundi, Void Altar
cards.flavor_text: Even angels whisper when they dream here.

cards.name: Secluded Starforge
cards.flavor_text: The family business was medicine stripped of mercy.

cards.name: Adagia, Windswept Bastion
cards.flavor_text: Somewhere, their lives were only a television show. That was the weird part.

cards.name: Vault of the Archangel
cards.flavor_text: Heaven preached peace and kept excellent weapons.

cards.name: Takenuma, Abandoned Mire
cards.flavor_text: The dead passed through. The living only glimpsed the doorway.

cards.name: Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance
cards.flavor_text: The candles were cheap. The consequences weren’t.

cards.name: Horizon of Progress
cards.flavor_text: The miles changed. The mission didn’t.

cards.name: Glittering Massif
cards.flavor_text: The gods checked in under false names and never truly checked out.

cards.name: Canyon Slough
cards.flavor_text: The infection spread faster than the warning signs could go up.

cards.name: Umbral Expanse
cards.flavor_text: Before creation, there was only silence without an edge.

cards.name: Shattered Landscape
cards.flavor_text: When Heaven won, almost everyone else lost.

cards.name: Cloud, Midgar Mercenary
cards.nickname: Arthur Ketch, Men of Letters Operative
cards.flavor_text: Efficiency came naturally. Conscience took longer.

cards.name: Danitha, Benalia's Hope
cards.flavor_text: Prophets speak for Heaven. Mothers speak louder.

cards.name: Puresteel Paladin
cards.flavor_text: Salt, iron, lore, and stubbornness kept more hunters alive than miracles ever did.

cards.name: Stoneforge Mystic
cards.flavor_text: Give her a locked door, a dead language, or a dragon. She’ll find a way in.

cards.name: Vilis, Broker of Blood
cards.flavor_text: Every soul has a price. Crowley simply knows the exchange rate.

cards.name: Brutal Cathar
cards.flavor_text: He hunted monsters without forgetting that some of them were still people.
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature enters or transforms into Garth, Monster Hunter, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield.
Daybound (If a player casts no spells during their own turn, it becomes night next turn.)

cards.name: Moonrage Brute
cards.flavor_text: The moon changed what he was, not who he chose to be.

cards.name: Archangel of Thune
cards.flavor_text: Born with the power to end worlds, he chose to save them.

cards.name: Witch of the Moors
cards.flavor_text: Death was never the end of a spell—only another ingredient.

cards.name: Loran of the Third Path
cards.flavor_text: Faith was optional. The evidence was not.

cards.name: Embercleave
cards.flavor_text: Even celestial blood answers to sharpened grace.

cards.name: Shadowspear
cards.flavor_text: Forged beyond this world, it knew where impossible things could bleed.

cards.name: Cecil, Dark Knight
cards.flavor_text: He taught Hell what a knight could become.

cards.name: Cecil, Redeemed Paladin
cards.flavor_text: The hardest blade to master was the one he chose not to draw.

cards.name: Archivist of Oghma
cards.nickname: Kevin Tran, Prophet of the Lord
cards.flavor_text: Prophecy never asked whether he had time for homework.

cards.name: The Regalia
cards.flavor_text: Home was four wheels, black paint, and whatever road came next.

cards.name: Excalibur, Sword of Eden
cards.flavor_text: Made for archangels. Fatal to nearly everything else.

cards.name: Mox Amber
cards.flavor_text: Some things become sacred because of who refuses to let them go.

cards.name: Mox Opal
cards.flavor_text: The Word of God was never meant to be easy reading.

cards.name: The Mind Stone
cards.flavor_text: Even Heaven can be reduced to something small enough to steal.

cards.name: Stonehewer Giant
cards.flavor_text: In the Bad Place, even the horizon could stand up and hunt you.

cards.name: Aerith Gainsborough
cards.flavor_text: She stopped waiting for permission to become the hunter she already was.

cards.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
cards.flavor_text: Purgatory taught him survival. Dean reminded him what survival was for.

cards.name: Knight Exemplar
cards.flavor_text: The Roadhouse had one rule: hunters came home if she could help it.

cards.name: Vona, Butcher of Magan
cards.flavor_text: Death doesn’t make exceptions. Billie makes appointments.

cards.name: Demonic Tutor
cards.flavor_text: Every ending is written somewhere. Finding yours is the dangerous part.

cards.name: Armored Skyhunter
cards.flavor_text: Who needs boots when you have wings?

cards.name: Nahiri, Forged in Fury
cards.flavor_text: In her world, surviving long enough to laugh was its own rebellion.

cards.name: Aettir and Priwen
cards.flavor_text: Wish carefully. The talisman has a sense of humor.

cards.name: Danitha Capashen, Paragon
cards.nickname: Eileen Leahy, Men of Letters Legacy
cards.flavor_text: She listened with her eyes and hunted with absolute precision.

cards.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER
cards.flavor_text: Heaven demanded obedience. Castiel chose responsibility.

cards.name: Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
cards.flavor_text: He swallowed Purgatory and mistook the weight for a crown.

cards.name: The Reaver Cleaver
cards.flavor_text: When the hammer falls, arguments about worthiness end quickly.

cards.name: Kaldra Compleat
cards.flavor_text: It does not kill. It decides that killing is complete.

cards.name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
cards.flavor_text: He fell from Heaven more than once, but never from his purpose.

cards.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
cards.flavor_text: The joke was always funniest just before reality changed.

cards.name: Ob Nixilis, the Ascended
cards.flavor_text: He never needed a throne to believe Heaven belonged to him.

cards.name: Éowyn, Fearless Knight
cards.flavor_text: She stopped waiting for angels to save her.

cards.name: Ria Ivor, Bane of Bladehold
cards.flavor_text: He didn’t bring disease. He simply reminded the world how easily it spreads.

cards.name: Riders of the Mark
cards.flavor_text: Anyone could become family. Anyone who threatened them became her problem.

cards.name: Rohirrim Chargers
cards.flavor_text: She met the impossible with a smile, a shotgun, and an ‘okey-dokey.’

cards.name: Thalia's Lancers
cards.flavor_text: People lied. Spirits lied. Missouri had little patience for either.

cards.name: Helm of the Host
cards.flavor_text: The best disguise is the one reality agrees to believe.

cards.name: Astor, Bearer of Blades
cards.flavor_text: Heaven had rules. Balthazar preferred souvenirs.

cards.name: Captain America, Liberator
cards.flavor_text: When the world ended, Bobby kept building places worth defending.

cards.name: Kelsien, the Plague
cards.flavor_text: Experience is what you get when the thing trying to kill you misses.

cards.name: Kaya the Inexorable
cards.flavor_text: Kings, angels, gods—eventually, they all become his business.

cards.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
cards.nickname: Mick Davies, Defier of the Code
cards.flavor_text: He learned the Code by heart, then learned when to break it.

cards.name: Imperial Recruiter
cards.flavor_text: Every monster leaves a pattern. Sam only needs enough time to find it.

cards.name: Sol Ring
cards.flavor_text: The oldest promise is the simplest: everything ends.

cards.name: Viridian Longbow
cards.flavor_text: It won’t kill a ghost. It will make one reconsider the room.

cards.name: Vorpal Sword
cards.flavor_text: Small enough to hide. Sharp enough to kill Heaven.

cards.name: Adaptive Omnitool
cards.flavor_text: When the boys didn’t know what they were hunting, John usually did.

cards.name: Arcane Signet
cards.flavor_text: One turn of the key, and a century of secrets opened.

cards.name: Resurrection Orb
cards.flavor_text: Some protections only prove themselves after your heart stops.

cards.name: Talisman of Conviction
cards.flavor_text: Slip it on, and every disagreement remembers how to become a war.

cards.name: Talisman of Hierarchy
cards.flavor_text: Where Pestilence passed, even the air learned to sicken.

cards.name: Talisman of Indulgence
cards.flavor_text: Hunger is easiest to command once it has already claimed you.

cards.name: Thornbite Staff
cards.flavor_text: It never asked Cain to kill. It only made killing easier.

cards.name: Sword of Light and Shadow
cards.flavor_text: Every forbidden answer leaves another stain on the page.

cards.name: Heartseeker
cards.flavor_text: Legends argued about what it couldn’t kill. Hunters cared what it could.

cards.name: Maskwood Nexus
cards.flavor_text: Eve’s greatest experiments began with one question: why stop at one monster?

cards.name: Thran Dynamo
cards.flavor_text: A million restless souls can power miracles—or monsters.

cards.name: Argentum Armor
cards.flavor_text: Built to wound beings who had forgotten what pain felt like.

cards.name: Meteor Sword
cards.flavor_text: Divine power rarely arrives with instructions.

cards.name: Fighter Class
cards.flavor_text: Rule one: there is always another rule you haven’t learned yet.

cards.name: Black Market Connections
cards.flavor_text: Hell remembers every favor, every debt, and every unpaid soul.

cards.name: Smothering Tithe
cards.flavor_text: The ink dries long before the regret does.

cards.flavor_text: Centuries of monsters, catalogued one impossible case at a time.
